articles.title: Goodbye Nimsdai: Incredible Story of the Man Who Conquered All 14 Highest Peaks
articles.description: The mountaineering world has lost a true legend. Nirmal 'Nimsdai' Purja inspired millions by achieving what many believed was impossible—climbing all 14 of the world's 8,000-metre peaks in just over six months. From serving in the elite Special Boat Service to rewriting mountaineering history with Project Possible, his journey was one of courage, determination, and resilience. In this video, we look back at the extraordinary life, unforgettable achievements, and lasting legacy of the climber who proved that nothing is impossible. Goodbye, Nimsdai. Your story will continue to inspire generations.

articles.title: Indian Navy Launches Final Diving Support Craft, Completes Indigenous Five Ship Programme
articles.description: The Indian Navy has launched DSC A24, the fifth and final vessel under its Diving Support Craft project, at Titagarh in West Bengal. Around 70 percent of the equipment has been sourced from Indian manufacturers, making the project a significant milestone under the Aatmanirbhar Bharat and Make in India initiatives while strengthening India's indigenous naval shipbuilding capabilities.

articles.title: Why wrapping garlic in aluminum foil changes everything and how safe is it? The science behind sweeter cloves, creamy texture and richer flavor
articles.description: Aluminum foil creates a miniature oven, trapping moisture and heat for gentle cooking. This humid environment softens garlic's cell walls, yielding a creamy texture. Heat deactivates enzymes, breaking down pungent sulfur compounds into milder flavors. Natural sugars become detectable as sharp notes diminish. Olive oil enhances texture and flavor transfer, making roasted garlic easier to digest.

articles.description: Mountaineering legend Nirmal 'Nimsdai' Purja tragically died in an avalanche on Pakistan's Broad Peak.
